# Crypto Wallet

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CryptoWallet`](gmeow-CryptoWallet.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CryptoWallet>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A digital wallet that holds cryptocurrency assets. A subclass of [`FinancialAccount`](gmeow-FinancialAccount.md) (it is a financial-existence account) with wallet-specific properties: address(es), scheme, and cryptographic key linkage.
